Home Sell Broken Gold

Why Broken Gold Loses Nothing at Our Counter

When you sell jewellery, you are selling metal content — gold that will be refined and reused. A chain does not contain less gold because its clasp snapped, and a single earring weighs exactly what it weighs. Yet many buyers use damage as a negotiating lever, quoting a lower 'scrap rate' for broken pieces. At Samridhi there is one rate logic for everything: the XRF Karatmeter shows the piece's actual purity on screen, the scale shows its weight, and the payout is pure-gold weight × the day's live rate — the same formula we use for a brand-new necklace.

Broken pieces are actually where transparent testing matters most. Old repairs sometimes include lower-karat solder joints, and a damaged piece can hide mixed-metal sections — an honest XRF reading shows you the true average purity of what you brought, instead of a buyer's guess that conveniently rounds down. If a section tests lower, you'll see it on the screen yourself and can decide with full information.

So gather the drawer of almost-jewellery — the broken, the bent, the one-of-a-pair — and bring it in together. Testing is free and takes minutes per piece; most customers are surprised how much the 'useless' pieces add up to. It pairs naturally with selling old gold or scrap gold in the same visit.

What We Accept

  • Broken chains, necklaces and mangalsutras
  • Single earrings and odd pieces — one of a pair is fine
  • Bent or broken bangles, bracelets and kada
  • Damaged rings and pendants, pieces with missing stones
  • Tangled, knotted or partially damaged jewellery
How It Works

From Testing to Payment in 10–15 Minutes

1

Walk Into Our Store

Visit us at Shop No. GF-04, Gaur City Centre, Gaur Chowk, Sector 4, Greater Noida West with your jewellery and one valid photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence).

2

Free XRF Testing

Your gold's purity is tested live on a German XRF Karatmeter. The result appears on screen in front of you — 100% transparent, zero damage.

3

Clear Valuation

We weigh your item in front of you and calculate the value from the live market rate and tested purity. Every number is explained — no hidden deductions.

4

Instant Payment

Accept the offer and get paid immediately by cash, NEFT or RTGS, with a proper invoice. The full process takes about 10–15 minutes.
